It is covered by the 2026-08-26 laptop-ingest freeze (P-09 footprint explicitly named in that decision's 'Does not unblock' list) but, unlike the factory reconcile job, carries no code-level LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN gate of its own -- a latent risk if anyone runs --apply from a laptop believing the absence of a code gate means it's allowed. DATA-QUALITY FINDING FOR THE OPERATOR: at real production scale, the dominant cause of building-footprint absence in both counties is a genuine ML-source coverage gap (85.7% of a 3000-parcel Bastrop sample; effectively 100% of a smaller, spatially-clustered Travis sample), not a join defect. No code fix in this lane's scope can manufacture a nearby footprint the Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints dataset never captured for these specific parcels. Closing this gap for real (both anchor parcels, and the broader Travis/Bastrop coverage holes it's representative of) needs a second acquisition source (e.g. county-GIS-derived footprints, or a newer ML vintage) -- an acquisition-scale decision for the operator/overseer, not a join-tuning fix, and explicitly not something this lane widened its own scope to attempt.
